deposits: WITH sampled AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT message_id, status, originating_transaction_hash IS NULL AS missing_hash, originating_transaction_block_number IS NULL AS missing_block, origination_timestamp IS NULL AS missing_timestamp, originator_address IS NULL AS missing_sender, completion_transaction_hash IS NULL AS missing_completion FROM arbitrum_crosslevel_messages WHERE direction='to_l2' ORDER BY message_id DESC LIMIT 10001 ), windowed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM sampled ORDER BY message_id DESC LIMIT 10000) SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'size',count(*),'truncated',((SELECT count(*)>10000 FROM sampled)::int), 'fully_linked',count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='relayed' AND NOT (missing_hash OR missing_block OR missing_timestamp OR missing_sender OR missing_completion)), 'incomplete_relayed',count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='relayed' AND (missing_hash OR missing_block OR missing_timestamp OR missing_sender OR missing_completion)), 'missing_hash',count(*) FILTER (WHERE missing_hash),'missing_block',count(*) FILTER (WHERE missing_block), 'missing_timestamp',count(*) FILTER (WHERE missing_timestamp),'missing_sender',count(*) FILTER (WHERE missing_sender), 'missing_completion',count(*) FILTER (WHERE missing_completion)) FROM windowed
withdrawals: WITH sampled AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT message_id AS id,status::text AS status,'0x'||encode(completion_transaction_hash,'hex') AS completion_hash FROM arbitrum_crosslevel_messages WHERE direction='from_l2' ORDER BY message_id DESC LIMIT 33 ), windowed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM sampled ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 32) SELECT jsonb_build_object('truncated',((SELECT count(*)>32 FROM sampled)::int), 'rows',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(w) ORDER BY id DESC) FROM windowed w),'[]'::jsonb))
batches: WITH sampled AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT number,commitment_id FROM arbitrum_l1_batches ORDER BY number DESC LIMIT 17 ), windowed AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT b.number,'0x'||encode(t.hash,'hex') AS hash,t.block_number AS parent_block,t.status::text AS status FROM (SELECT * FROM sampled ORDER BY number DESC LIMIT 16) b LEFT JOIN arbitrum_lifecycle_l1_transactions t ON t.id=b.commitment_id ) SELECT jsonb_build_object('truncated',((SELECT count(*)>16 FROM sampled)::int), 'rows',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(w) ORDER BY number DESC) FROM windowed w),'[]'::jsonb))
